description: This is a CMake module script designed to locate and configure the systemd library for the build system. It checks for the presence of systemd, sets relevant variables, and defines imported targets if found.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Locates a package configuration for a specific library or tool.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Uses pkg-config to check for the presence of required modules.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds a library file on the system.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Finds the directory path to a header or file.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard arguments and success/error messaging for find_package modules.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to hide them in CMake GUIs.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Defines a new library target, in this case an imported one.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties on a target, such as location and include directories.
